administration.timeframe: General self-description, not a specified recent-week recall period
administration.instructionZh: 请根据你通常的情况，判断以下说法与你的符合程度。没有标准答案，请按自己的真实感受作答。

responseOptions.zh: 介于不符合与符合之间

administration.populationCaution: Adult research-only is a conservative project use boundary, not proof of validation in Chinese adults, teachers or minors.

scoring.missing: Require all 10 responses; no imputation. This is a project implementation choice, not a source-defined missingness rule.

norms.note: No cutoffs, diagnostic bands, Chinese percentiles or school norms are supported by the reviewed official pages. Do not use response-range thirds as empirical thresholds.

items.en: Like to watch children open presents.
items.zh: 我喜欢看孩子们拆礼物。

items.en: Usually end up laughing if the people around me are laughing.
items.zh: 如果周围的人在笑，我通常也会跟着笑起来。
我能感受到他人的喜悦。

items.en: Get caught up in the excitement when others are celebrating.
items.zh: 当他人庆祝时，我也会受到那种兴奋气氛的感染。

items.en: Am strongly influenced by the good moods of others.
items.zh: 他人的好心情会对我产生很大的影响。

items.en: Find it hard to stay in a bad mood if the people around me are happy.
items.zh: 如果周围的人很开心，我就很难一直保持坏心情。

items.en: Dislike being around happy people when I'm feeling sad.
items.zh: 当我感到难过时，我不喜欢待在开心的人身边。

items.en: Am unaffected by other people's happiness.
items.zh: 他人的快乐不会影响到我。

items.en: Rarely get caught up in the excitement.
items.zh: 我很少被兴奋的气氛所感染。
我不喜欢孩子们的生日聚会。

reliability.interpretation: Group-level original source coefficients, not current Chinese reliability or individual accuracy.

construct: Self-reported tendency to share or be influenced by others' positive affect; not overall empathy, kindness, moral quality or professional competence.

feedback.summary: 分数概括你在他人开心或庆祝时受到积极情绪感染的自述倾向。它不代表整体共情能力，也不用于判断是否关心别人。
feedback.reflection: 回想一次他人分享好消息时，你内心有什么反应？你用什么方式表达回应？
feedback.action: 如果愿意，可以问一句具体的问题，让对方多讲讲令其开心的事情；不需要强迫自己表现出同样强烈的情绪。
feedback.limits: 题目含儿童礼物、生日聚会等情境，生活经历与文化背景会影响回答；不可据此评价教师、亲职或照顾能力。无中国常模或经验分界值。
